title: Lake Austin Private Party Boat 2-Hour Swim, BYOB, Lily Pad
includes: U.S. Coast Guard–approved life vests for use during the tour
Private pontoon boat reserved exclusively for your group
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Plan to arrive 30 minutes early for parking and entry
A waiver and release of liability must be signed prior to boarding
This tour departs from and returns to a public Travis County boat ramp with limited weekend parking; rideshare is recommended
No restroom on the boat; please use facilities prior to boarding
Restroom breaks may be requested during the rental
The boat features a dual overhead canopy for full or partial sun shading
Please come prepared for outdoor weather (hat, sunscreen, etc.)
Food and alcoholic beverages are permitted
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Cruise Lake Austin on a private pontoon party boat reserved exclusively for your group, with time to swim, float, relax, and enjoy your favorite drinks on the water. Perfect for birthdays, bachelorette and bachelor parties, graduations, and fun lake days with friends and family.

Enjoy a spacious, comfortable ride with an experienced, boat safety–certified captain, full or partial overhead shade, and a flexible itinerary tailored to your group’s pace. Anchor in a calm cove to swim and lounge on the included Aqua Lily Pad, or cruise past the Pennybacker Bridge, waterfront homes, and popular lakeside spots.

Lake Austin’s constant water level provides ideal conditions for swimming and floating, while the private boat setting lets you play music, socialize, and celebrate without sharing space with other guests. Bring your own beverages and snacks and enjoy a relaxed, customizable lake experience just minutes from downtown Austin.
